caption: Golden-brown, glossy miso broth with oil sheen and green flecks swirls around noodles, featuring a halved boiled egg, dark green nori, pinkish chashu pork, and pale yellow menma. Served in a blue and white ceramic bowl on dark speckled granite, with a white ceramic spoon.

segments_info.text: Dark speckled granite surface with visible grain patterns and subtle texture variations.
The chashu pork is a round, sliced piece with pinkish meat, white fat, and a slightly glistening surface.
The nori seaweed is dark green, textured, irregularly shaped, and has a slightly rough surface with visible veins.
The miso broth is golden-brown, glossy, and rich, swirling around noodles and toppings with visible oil sheen and scattered green flecks.
Menma bamboo shoots appear as pale yellow, slightly translucent, elongated strips with a smooth, glossy surface.
A halved boiled egg shows a vibrant orange yolk surrounded by a pale, firm white with a slightly textured surface.
Blue and white ceramic bowl with intricate patterned rim, smooth surface, and slight sheen from ambient light.
A white ceramic spoon with smooth, glossy surface and slightly curved bowl shape.
